post.summary: Create Prime Change Order Line Item
post.description: Creates a line item for a given prime change order.

parameters.name: prime_change_order_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Prime Change Order. See `GET /rest/v1.0/projects/{project_id}/prime_change_orders`.

prime_line_item_id.description: ID of the prime contract line item associated with this line item. Pass null when updating to remove the association.

rate_value_id.description: ID of the project rate value selected for this line item. Accepted only for unit-quantity schedules of values. Pass null when updating to clear the selected rate.

resource_id.description: ID of the resource assigned to this line item. When provided with a rate value, the resource must match the resource associated with that rate. Accepted only for unit-quantity schedules of values. Pass null when updating to clear the assigned resource.

amount.description: Amount - this field is nullable on unit quantity SOVs but NOT amount-based SOVs. For line item creates, if this field is omitted on unit quantity SOVs,  the amount will be calculated as quantity * unit_cost. For line item updates, if a null amount is passed in on unit quantity SOVs, it will set the line item extended type to "calculated".

quantity.description: Quantity - only accepted on unit quantity SOVs

unit_cost.description: Unit cost - only accepted on unit quantity SOVs

uom.description: Unit of measure - only accepted on unit quantity SOVs
enum: Any value present in the Company list of Units of Measure

funding_rule_id.description: ID of the funding rule associated with this line item. Funding Sources must be enabled at the project level. The rule must be ACTIVE and its currency must match the contract currency. Pass null to disassociate an existing funding rule.

data.title: Line Item Row
data.description: A row on a schedule of values.

prime_line_item_id.description: ID of the prime contract line item associated with this line item

funding_rule_id.description: ID of the funding rule associated with this line item

resource.description: Rate and resource selection associated with a line item.

rate_value_id.description: ID of the selected rate value. Null when the line item uses a manually entered rate.

currency_iso_code.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the selected or manually entered rate.

resource_category.description: Category used to classify the selected labor, equipment, or other resource. Null when no resource is assigned.

resource_id.description: ID of the resource assigned to the line item. Null when no resource is assigned.

resource_name.description: Display name of the resource assigned to the line item. Null when no resource is assigned.

unit_cost.description: An "unformatted" decimal number. Specifically a number with a period as the decimal separator, without a thousands separator, and with an optional sign. It should be assumed that this number includes arbitrary precision and scale, however, the API may not store or process the number with infinite precision and scale.

amount.description: An "unformatted" decimal number. Specifically a number with a period as the decimal separator, without a thousands separator, and with an optional sign. position.description: Position of the line item within the schedule of values

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"prime_line_item_id\":\"12345\",\"rate_value_id\":\"01JFHMDB8AD4750F18KN8R2TF1\",\"resource_id\":\"01JFHMDB8AD4750F18KN8R2TF2\",\"amount\":\"1000.0\",\"description\":\"Cleanup\",\"quantity\":\"20.0\",\"unit_cost\":\"50.00\",\"uom\":\"Hours\",\"wbs_code_id\":\"34567\",\"tax_code_id\":\"12345\",\"funding_rule_id\":\"12345\"}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/prime_change_orders/%7Bprime_change_order_id%7D/line_items/%7Bid%7D", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.summary: Notice of General Availability
x-changelog.description: This endpoint is now generally available (GA).

x-changelog.summary: Added wbs_code field to response
x-changelog.description: The response now includes a wbs_code object with id, flat_code, and description fields when the line item has an associated WBS code.

x-changelog.summary: Tax code parameter behavior when tax is disabled
x-changelog.description: If tax is disabled on the tool or on the project, the tax_code_id parameter will be ignored when creating or updating line items.

x-changelog.summary: Added funding_rule_id parameter and response field
x-changelog.description: Accepts an optional funding_rule_id parameter associating the line item with a project-level funding rule, and returns funding_rule_id on the response. Funding Sources must be enabled at the project level. The rule must be ACTIVE and its currency must match the parent contract currency. Pass null to disassociate.

x-changelog.summary: Remove phantom work_breakdown_structure from response schema
x-changelog.description: Removed the work_breakdown_structure property from the PATCH response schema. This field was never returned by the API implementation. Documentation-only correction; no runtime change.

x-changelog.summary: Added resource data to the response
x-changelog.description: The response may now include a resource object describing the line item's selected rate value, currency, and assigned resource.

x-changelog.summary: Added rate and resource selection parameters
x-changelog.description: Accepts optional rate_value_id and resource_id parameters when updating a line item on a unit-quantity schedule of values. Pass null to clear the selected rate or assigned resource.
